name: Rubber Segment
description: A segmented bar with a rubbery glass thumb: it stretches as it jumps, sets an anchor and glides into the new cell with momentum.
interactionNotes: Clicking any cell makes the glass thumb spring to that cell, stretching mid-flight and squashing its trailing edge. Dragging the thumb across the bar lets you move between cells; releasing with speed gives momentum and settles it on the nearest cell. Arrow keys also work — in RTL `ArrowLeft` moves forward.

props.name: items
props.description: The options; a string or a `{ value, label, icon }` object.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled mode; pass it to own the value control.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value in uncontrolled mode; if omitted, the first option.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called on every settled change.

props.name: trackColor
props.description: Background of the bar.

props.name: thumbColor
props.description: Color of the glass thumb.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color of inactive options.

props.name: activeTextColor
props.description: Text color of the one the thumb sits on.

props.name: size
props.description: Bar and text size.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner rounding, in pixels.

props.name: inset
props.description: Inner margin of the thumb from the bar's edge, in pixels.

props.name: equalSlots
props.description: Equal width for all options.

props.name: stretch
props.description: Stretch percentage during the jump; zero means no stretch.

props.name: squash
props.description: Squash amount of the trailing edge, in pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier; 1 is the default.

props.name: glide
props.description: Momentum glide on release, 0 to 100.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Whether dragging the thumb across the bar is enabled.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dimmed and unresponsive to input.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the radio group.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

tips: For Persian, a three-to-four option bar is the sweet spot; keep `equalSlots` on so the cells are the same size and the thumb does not wobble in the middle.
This component needs no manual mirroring: the reading direction of the layout comes from the page's own flex, and the arrow keys swap based on `direction` — in RTL `ArrowLeft` moves forward.

If the indicators are too low-contrast (a light background with a light bar), make `trackColor` one step darker than the surface, not one step lighter; this is the only place where the bar's contrast shows.
With `prefers-reduced-motion` the spring jump becomes a simple change; momentum and stretch also turn off but selection still works correctly.
